As of 2026-11-25 JST, since the pages went out on 2026-11-14, the Bing AI performance report had been opened twice, on 2026-11-23 and 2026-11-25. The screen images taken then show only the site-wide totals and the daily line, not the page-level or query-level tables, and no page was changed because of them. Other parts of Bing Webmaster Tools (sitemaps, URL inspection, recommendations) were also used in that time. Any later opening before the reading is reported with the result.
